choice: Create and close Dock tabs instead of moving them; name the server tab with an OSC title from the helper; stop the server before closing its terminal; quote the program path in `new-surface --command`, which is typed into a shell.
context: Moving the running server terminal into the page's Dock pane failed, and so did renaming and closing its tab.
rejected: `move-surface`, `rename-tab` and `surface open --pane`: they look up surfaces in the caller's workspace and do not find Dock tabs. `close-surface` on a terminal with a running program: fails with internal_error until the program exits.
title: Most cmux surface commands cannot address Dock tabs
